subject: Significance Thresholds for QTL under selective genotyping

messages.author: 3fc0aa17517d1931
messages.subject: Significance Thresholds for QTL under selective genotyping
parts:
We are doing some QTL mapping using Selective genotyping strategy. And
I read the nice paper from Prof. Broman " Significance Threasholds for
QTL mapping under selective genotyping". It suggests that we should
use a stratified permutation to establish the threashold. But is there
any R code available? I donot know how to permute the data within
different group by R/qtl

messages.author: d5fdb09d679f8c32
messages.subject: Re: Significance Thresholds for QTL under selective genotyping
parts:
Use the "perm.strata" argument in "scanone," for example as follows.

# regular genome scan without stratified permutations
out <- scanone(hyper,n.perm=1000)
# create strata according to genotyping intensity
extremes <- (nmissing(hyper)/totmar(hyper) < 0.5)
# permute within strata according to strata defined above
operm.strat <- scanone(hyper, n.perm=1000,perm.strata=extremes)

Saunak
